subject: Ciências da Natureza e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Interpretar resultados e realizar previsões sobre atividades experimentais, fenômenos naturais e processos tecnológicos, com base nas noções de probabilidade e incerteza, reconhecendo os limites explicativos das ciências.

components.description_pt: Usar conceitos de probabilidade para avaliar incerteza em conclusões científicas e de engenharia
components.description_en: Use probability concepts to evaluate uncertainty in scientific and engineering conclusions
components.cc_component_description: Use probability concepts to evaluate uncertainty in scientific and engineering conclusions

components.description_pt: Prever resultados de fenômenos naturais baseado em raciocínio probabilístico
components.description_en: Predict outcomes of natural phenomena based on probabilistic reasoning
components.cc_component_description: Apply knowledge of cause-and-effect relationships to predict outcomes of similar events

components.description_pt: Avaliar resultados de processos tecnológicos aplicando conceitos de incerteza
components.description_en: Evaluate technological process results by applying uncertainty concepts
components.cc_component_description: Use probability concepts to evaluate uncertainty in scientific and engineering conclusions

components.description_pt: Avaliar as limitações de um modelo científico em representar com precisão um sistema real
components.description_en: Evaluate the limitations of a scientific model in accurately representing a real-world system
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the limitations of a scientific model in accurately representing a real-world system

cc_matches.description: Apply concepts of statistics and probability (including determining function fits to data, slope, intercept, and correlation coefficient for linear fits) to scientific and engineering questions and problems, using digital tools when feasible.
Events have causes that generate observable patterns.
